acceptedAnswer.text: An IoT mold risk prevention and detection system: a sensor pod that scores the Mold Risk Index for a room and can automatically control dehumidification.

mainEntity.name: How does it detect mold risk?

acceptedAnswer.text: It scores the conditions mold needs rather than looking for mold. The Mold Risk Index combines humidity, temperature, and how long those conditions persist, instead of reacting to a single humidity threshold. Outdoor forecast data sharpens that window further.
Yes, it is one. MoldGuard contains its own thermoelectric dehumidifier: when the index crosses the threshold it starts pulling moisture down by itself.

Live status and history: the room, the readings behind the score, and humidity, temperature and dew-point trends over time (multi-room and multi-unit views are planned as a premium tier). You can step in with manual override from anywhere, any time.

mainEntity.name: Can I monitor more than one room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not in the base product. Multi-room and multi-unit views are planned as an optional premium tier for larger households, dormitories or property managers.

mainEntity.name: How do I set it up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plug in, connect, done. Place the unit tabletop or wall-mounted, connect it to Wi-Fi, and watch the loop run.

mainEntity.name: What happens if the internet goes down?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bluetooth Low Energy keeps local monitoring and manual control working, and the dehumidification logic keeps running autonomously either way. One phone at a time over Bluetooth; several devices can connect over Wi-Fi.
The loop runs on the device. Live status and history, alerts, and manual override are the parts that travel through the app and web dashboard.

mainEntity.name: Does it work without the internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: One development cost, no monthly fees. Standard, individually sourced parts inside one unit: sensors, a thermoelectric stack and a water tank. The hardware is yours, with no proprietary ecosystem.
One small enclosed room, about 30 m\u00b3 (roughly 2.9 \u00d7 4.2 \u00d7 2.4 m), which is what the 1-litre reservoir is sized for. Larger or open-plan spaces are outside scope.

mainEntity.name: What room size does it handle?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renters and small property owners, larger households, dormitories, and property managers.
